settings.custom_title: SKU00001 - Maxi Comfort 360° Hydraulic Massage Table
settings.intro_highlight: The Maxi Comfort 360° is a premier hydraulic facial bed and massage table engineered for exceptional client comfort and effortless practitioner mobility. Featuring a full 360-degree rotational swivel base and multi-position reclining adjustments, this professional unit delivers top-tier performance for advanced esthetics, medical spa procedures, and specialized treatments.
settings.custom_description: Designed specifically for licensed estheticians, medical spa professionals, and clinical massage therapists, the Maxi Comfort 360° bridges the gap between ergonomic support and absolute versatility. Its heavy-duty hydraulic foot pump enables smooth height adjustments, while the mechanical backrest and leg rest transition seamlessly into a comfortable “La-z-boy” reclining position (up to 15°). The 360-degree rotation allows practitioners to pivot the table effortlessly around the treatment room, reducing physical strain, optimizing workflow efficiency, and ensuring superior client positioning during complex procedures.
settings.subtitle: Ergonomic 360° Swivel & Hydraulic Elevation
settings.secondary_description: Built to withstand the rigorous demands of high-volume aesthetic clinics and day spas, the Maxi Comfort 360° features high-density cushion padding wrapped in tough, premium-grade vinyl upholstery designed for effortless daily sanitation and chemical resistance. To preserve the pristine finish and structural mechanism across its extended operational lifespan, regular surface cleaning with recommended clinical disinfectants and periodic lubrication of moving hydraulic pivot points is advised. Consistent maintenance guarantees long-term stability, protects upholstery integrity, and maximizes return on salon investment.

settings.question: Licensed Esthetician & Facial Specialist:
settings.answer: The Maxi Comfort 360° provides an ideal operating platform for multi-modality facial treatments, microdermabrasion, and chemical peels. The removable armrests and adjustable headrest enable close, unobstructed access to the facial and neck zones, protecting the practitioner from awkward posture and reducing lower-back fatigue during prolonged client sessions.

settings.question: Medical Spa & Clinical Technician:
settings.answer: In fast-paced clinical environments where equipment agility is paramount, the full 360-degree rotation mechanism allows technicians to pivot the entire bed smoothly to accommodate specialized laser devices, lighting rigs, or procedural carts without repositioning the client.

settings.question: Advanced Body Massage Therapist:
settings.answer: Engineered to support comprehensive bodywork, electrolysis, and depilation, the table includes two specialized massage therapy bolsters and supports flat horizontal positioning or an inclined reclining lounge posture, adapting instantly to diverse service menus.

settings.title: 360° Rotational Agility
settings.text: Effortless Swivel Base: Engineered to rotate a full 360 degrees, granting practitioners unobstructed access around the treatment room without moving the client base.

settings.title: Hydraulic Elevation System
settings.text: Foot-Activated Height Control: Heavy-duty hydraulic pump mechanism allows smooth, electricity-free vertical adjustment from 26.5" to 33.5".

settings.title: Ergonomic Versatility
settings.text: Multi-Position Recline: Transitions smoothly into a specialized 'La-z-boy' lounge position (15°) with removable armrests and matching therapy bolsters.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Position the heavy-duty base on a completely flat, level salon floor with adequate clearance around the perimeter to permit full 360-degree rotation.
Depress the hydraulic foot pump repeatedly to raise the bed to the desired treatment height, or apply downward body weight while releasing the valve to lower it.
Engage the mechanical release levers to adjust the backrest and leg sections into your desired incline or flat treatment configuration.
Unlock the rotation brake mechanism when you need to pivot the table smoothly during multi-stage treatments, locking it back in place before client boarding.
Ensure clients are seated centrally on the cushion platform and avoid standing or applying concentrated point-loads on the extreme edges of the footrest.
Periodically inspect the mechanical levers and hydraulic cylinder mountings, deferring any internal hydraulic repairs exclusively to certified Equipro technicians.
Clean vinyl surfaces immediately following treatments using approved non-abrasive hospital-grade disinfectants to prevent chemical degradation.

settings.question: What accessories come standard with the Maxi Comfort 360°?
settings.answer: The table includes removable armrests, an adjustable headrest, and 2 custom massage therapy bolsters. This complete set equips your treatment room for immediate versatile service delivery.

settings.question: What is the net weight and overall structural footprint of the bed?
settings.answer: The unit weighs 152 lbs and measures 24 inches wide by 71 inches long. Its compact footprint is optimized for smaller treatment rooms while providing robust client stability.

settings.question: What is the adjustable height range for this hydraulic model?
settings.answer: The table height adjusts smoothly from 26.5 inches to 33.5 inches. This range accommodates diverse esthetician heights and specialized procedural requirements.

settings.question: Does the table require an electrical power outlet to operate?
settings.answer: No electrical connection is needed. The height is controlled via a hydraulic foot pump, and recline adjustments are handled mechanically, maximizing placement freedom in any treatment room.

settings.question: What manufacturer warranty protects this professional equipment?
settings.answer: Equipro covers the Maxi Comfort 360° with a comprehensive 2-Year Limited Warranty. This warranty covers the heavy-duty hydraulic pump mechanism and structural steel frame.
